subject: kernel ABI for async job chains (0090): WAIT_SEQ, host-only
body: No GPU IRQ exists; completion is polled and WAIT used IOSleep(1) (=~2.4 ms/job). 0090: WAIT/WAIT_SEQ poll with IODelay 20us then 100us, 1ms tick while jobs pending. New selector NORD2_GPU_SEL_WAIT_SEQ=12: in {seq,timeout_ms<=5000}, out {state(4=all DONE,5/6/7=lowest failing job state,2=timeout nothing reaped), completed_count, first_failed_id}, optional nord2_gpu_fault_info struct out. Waits until ALL jobs of this context with id<=seq terminal and reaps them. SUBMIT_JM already returns id immediately; ids monotonic, per-context strictly in order; in-flight window NORD2_GPU_MAX_INFLIGHT=96 unfinished jobs per client (kIOReturnBusy beyond -> WAIT_SEQ then resubmit); all BOs of a job stay kernel-retained until it finishes; old WAIT(id) unchanged. Suggested bridge use: submit every job of the command buffer, one WAIT_SEQ(last_id). Details: gpu/build/kernel-p1-20261026/README-0088-0091.md, headers gpu/include/nord2_gpu_transport.h in candidate-gpu-source-0090.patch. Not yet on device.
